hints.title: Row-by-Row Max Selection
hints.text: In each round, the largest remaining element is removed from every row.

hints.title: Row Sorting Alignment
hints.text: Sorting each row aligns elements so that column j contains all values removed in step j.

hints.title: Column Maximum Summation
hints.text: For each column position, find the maximum value across all rows and add it to the total score.

hints.title: Row Sorting and Column Max Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting each row followed by linear column-wise maximum scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching and deleting maximums repeatedly without sorting takes O(m * n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space modifying rows in place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts rows to process each removal round in parallel.
